definitions.gloss: real estate transaction specialist qualification (and its exam)
definitions.explanation: A common abbreviation of {宅地建物取引士|たくちたてものとりひきし}, the national qualification (and the exam for it) required to handle certain steps in real estate transactions in Japan. Also used for the license and the profession.

examples.japanese: {宅建|たっけん}の{資格|しかく}を{取|と}った。
examples.english: I got the real estate transaction specialist qualification.

examples.japanese: {宅建|たっけん}の{試験|しけん}は{毎年|まいとし}{十月|じゅうがつ}にある。
examples.english: The real estate specialist exam is held every October.

examples.japanese: {不動産|ふどうさん}{会社|がいしゃ}で{働|はたら}くために、{今年|ことし}{宅建|たっけん}に{合格|ごうかく}したい。
examples.english: I want to pass the real estate specialist exam this year so I can work at a real estate company.

notes:
A widely-used shortening of {宅地建物取引士|たくちたてものとりひきし} (formerly {宅地建物取引主任者|たくちたてものとりひきしゅにんしゃ}). One of Japan's most popular national qualifications; the word usually refers to the exam or the license in everyday speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宅建|たっけん}を{取|と}る: to obtain the qualification
- {宅建|たっけん}に{合格|ごうかく}する: to pass the exam
- {宅建|たっけん}{試験|しけん}: the real estate specialist exam
- {宅建|たっけん}{士|し}: a licensed real estate transaction specialist
